reviews.reason: History input now composes the shared DebugComposer with disabled=true, empty controlled value, false activity flags and module-level no-op callbacks. Model/reasoning metadata move into its footerActions slot. No editable input or send mutation is introduced. The component intentionally has no editable draft/send path. Its controlled disabled Sender contract is shared with history viewers; this is not an accidentally uncontrolled editable field. The focused read-only composer tests assert disabled input and send, ignored Enter/click, metadata in the footer and no interactive model selector.
